text:
Alex: Heads-up — we're in SF SoMa next Tue for the conf. Anyone have go-to spots near the convention center for breakfast/lunch/dinner? Need options for vegan + late-night. Also thinking group dinner Fri night.
Priya: Breakfast — SFMX Tacos on 3rd, great breakfast burritos, open 7am. cheap.
Marco: Ramen Ya-Ya on Howard is solid, late hours, good for post-demo unwind. :ramen: 🍜
Sam: Any vegan options? I prefer something without cross-contamination.
Lena: Greens & Grains (on Folsom) has full vegan menu and big tables. patio for 6-8.
Alex: Nice — does Greens take reservations? We have ~8 ppl.
Lena: They take reservations for >6, call ☎️ 415-555-0199. Also right next to a bar if people want drinks after.
Priya: If we want cheap group dinner: Flamebox (donburi bowls) — quick, counter service, good for tight schedules.
Marco: For delivery to hotel rooms, Collective Kitchen on 4th has reliable UberEats + family-style trays.
Sam: Quick poll: 🍕 pizza, 🌮 tacos, 🍜 ramen, 🥗 vegan. Reply with an emoji to vote.
ops-bot: Reminder: Team dinner budget is $40/head per ops manual. If exceed, ping @finance.
Alex: I'll collect votes and book Greens for Fri at 7pm if vegan wins, else ramen for 7:30. Thanks all!
Priya: Vote: 🥗
